entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your painful stare burns through your opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Mesmerist level 11th, painful stare class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you trigger a painful stare, the target must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your mesmerist level + your Charisma modifier) or become sickened by the pain for 1 round.
